contribution.position: Holding my earlier position. Answering product: it says nobody else sees a reliability problem and treats the axis as settled. That is not supported. artifact:incident-log shows a 30-day error rate of 1.8% against a 0.3% SLO (six times over) and two sev2 incidents, and no other role has addressed it. Their silence is not evidence. Product's cost point stands on artifact:cost-sheet (+3% vs 5% ceiling), but cost says nothing about reliability. Answering qa: artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) shows functional correctness in test, not production error behavior, so it does not support calling risk contained given the incident history. Answering ops: artifact:ops-runbook v4 covers deploy and rollback, which limits blast radius but does not reduce the baseline error rate. Gaps I name: the transcript cites no artifact showing the change's effect on production error rate, no root-cause analysis for the two sev2s, and no mapping of whether the change touches those code paths. The perf-report (p99 within budget at peak) covers latency, not errors. Until that evidence exists, reliability remains open.
